scope: Proposition 6.1 (A realization interface for the game) of the manuscript “Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs” (preprints/Variable-dimension-Weisfeiler-Leman-equivalence-on-general-and-subcubic-graphs-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 133 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5b3048ce062b1b8e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 23-24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a product scalar-image instance have address length r ≥ 3, put K = r + 1, and form its affine block data. Suppose finite simple graphs W0, W1 of the same positive order have partitions V (Wε ) = ∐ B∈B V ε B (ε ∈ {0, 1}) with the following properties. 1. For every block B and offset ξB ∈ Z1 B, there is a fixed bijection ΨB,ξB : V 0 B → V 1 B, depending only on that offset and the constructed graphs. Whenever offsets on a set of blocks agree on shared readouts, the union of their maps is an isomorphism of the induced subgraphs on the corresponding parts. 2. For every B, ε, and z ∈ Zε B, there is a nonempty set Dε B(z) ⊆ V ε B; for fixed B, ε, these sets are pairwise disjoint. At every history reached under any winning K-slot strategy, a marked vertex in D0 B(0) is answered by a vertex in D1 B(ζB) for some ζB ∈ Z1 B. For simultaneous such marks in distinct blocks B, C, the decoded valuations ζB, ζC agree on every shared readout. These assertions apply also when all slots are occupied. 23 Then the instance is consistent ⇐⇒ Duplicator wins on W0 , W1 with K slots ⇐⇒ W0 ≡r W1 .
